name: City Council Special Community Meeting - Meetup with the Mayor
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL OF MONTEREY PARK
  CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

  NOTICE OF CITY COUNCIL SPECIAL COMMUNITY MEETING

  As a quorum of the City Council may be present for the event, this special meeting
  notice is being issued for the purpose of the Brown Act pursuant to Government
  Code Section 54956.1 Members of the City Council present will not formally
  convene as a body, nor will they take any formal action at the event.

  MEETUP WITH THE MAYOR

  360 Labs
  1101 Monterey Pass Rd., Monterey Park 91754

  Thursday
  July 24, 2025
  5:00 p.m. – 6:00 p.m.

  I.  Welcome

  II.  Community members are invited for casual conversations and to learn more
  about the City with the Mayor of Monterey Park.

  III.  Adjournment

(April 18, 2024) [Opn. No. 23-102 at 2024 WL 1812958].
minutes_text:
73-231

  Minutes
  Monterey Park City Council
  Special Community Meeting
  July 24, 2025

The City Council of the City of Monterey Park held a Special Community Meeting of the Council
at 360 Labs located at 1101 Monterey Pass Rd., Monterey Park 91754 on Thursday, July 24,
2025, at 5:00 p.m.

1.  Call to Order
  City Manager Alvarez called the meeting to order at 5:00 p.m.

2.  Roll Call

  City Clerk Maychelle Yee called the roll:

  Council Members Present:  Vinh Ngo, Thomas Wong at 5:21 p.m.
  Council Members Absent:  Jose Sanchez, Henry Lo, Elizabeth Yang

  Also Present:
  Assistant City Manager Diana Garcia
  Director of Finance Martha Garcia
  Director of Human Resources and Risk Management
  Director of Public Works Shawn Igoe
  Director of Recreation and Community Services Robert Aguirre
  Interim Director of Community Development Philip Lanzafame
  Police Captain Gus Jimenez
  Fire Captain Jon Gin
  Police Lieutenant Bing Han
  Police Sergeant Raymond Cota
  Economic Development Manager Joeseph Torres
  Finance Manager Laura Borjon
  Senior Accountant June Leung
  Economic Development Specialist Janice Huang
  Assistant Deputy City Clerk Helena Cho

  Meet Up with The Mayor

  I.  Welcome

  II.  Community members are invited for casual conversations and to learn more
  about the City with the Mayor of Monterey Park

  III.  Adjournment

  MISSION STATEMENT
 The mission of the City of Monterey Park is to provide excellent service, foster growth and opportunity,
  and create a joyous and collaborative environment.
  .
   73-232
  July 24, 2025
  Due to a lack of quorum, the meeting was adjourned at 5:45 p.m. by City Manager
  Alvarez.

_________________
Maychelle Yee
City Clerk
